title: Measure E2's two performance numbers and the per-Meal model cost
objective: Replace three estimates with measurements the founder can decide on: how long a Cook waits, and what one published Meal costs to run.
acceptance_criteria: description-finished to first estimate is measured against the 2s budget, with the method recorded
confirm to on-offer is measured against the 3s budget, with the method recorded
the model cost of one published Meal is measured and reported as a figure, alongside E1's still-open per-verification cost
every number states how many runs it averages — one run is not a measurement
notes: The numbers are the founder's to act on, not the worker's. Measure and report; do not change a budget or optimise against it without asking. STATUS 2026-08-05, PR 32: T076 measured ($0.82 per 1,000 published Meals without a photo, $1.99 with). Confirm-to-on-offer measured: 12 runs, median 189 ms against a 3s budget, PASS. Description-finished-to-first-estimate NOT measured — a Supabase preview branch carries no model credential, so all 12 calls returned 502 provider_misconfigured; composing the three measured parts suggests ~2.4s against a 2s budget, reported as arithmetic rather than a result. Found and fixed en route: the live database granted no application role any DML privilege, so the app could not read or write a row in production. Spend $0.59 against a $0.50 envelope; the overrun is the grants work, which was not in the package.
